name: Iran nuclear programme
summary: No IAEA access to key Iranian sites; US strikes so far hit military, not nuclear, targets
state: The IAEA has had no access to key Iranian sites since the war began. US strikes on 3 Nov hit an air-defence site on Qeshm Island, not nuclear facilities (Stars and Stripes), and Iran called the US reply to its Hormuz plan unconvincing on 4 Nov (Al Jazeera). Searches on 6 Nov found no strike on a nuclear site, NPT withdrawal or new IAEA report.
for_you: No direct public effect; a strike on nuclear sites would sharply raise regional and energy-market risk.
rubric_hit: Inspector access curtailed + credible strike threats = Watch

sources.title: Stars and Stripes — US quietly strikes Iranian island in Strait of Hormuz
Al Jazeera — Iran says US reply to Hormuz plan 'unconvincing'

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.
drivers: Enrichment levels, IAEA access, Israeli/US military posture, snapback sanctions, talks.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
